DIAGNOSTICS - AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE (U34tE)
INSPECTION PROCEDURE
1 Check voltage between terminal OD1 of ECM and body ground.
PREPARATION:
Turn the ignition switch ON.
CHECK:
Measure voltage between terminal 001 of ECM and body
ground.
OK:
Voltage: 10 -14 V
N · Proceed to next circuit Inspection shown on
problem symptoms table (See page D1-234). L_/
2 Check voltage between terminal OD of cruise control ECU harness side connec­
tor and body ground.
PREPARATION:
(a) Disconnect the cruise control ECU connector.
0/D (b) Tum the ignition switch ON.
CHECK:
Measure voltage between terminal OD of cruise control ECU
harness side connector and body ground.
OK:
Voltage: 10-14 V

Check and replace the cruise control ECU. 8
